g.text: The metadata ledger trial of one V2 commit
activating the successor before deactivating the predecessor expands only the objects that change
Seeded once at cold admission (T7): every metadata object counts
its root multiplicity plus its occurrences as a child of a distinct
metadata object, so X and Y count 1 (each is a child of r) and the
anchor A counts 1. This is the ledger that activating A from an
empty domain builds, obtained without reading an object again.
load the old search path r, n1, L1
stage r', n1', m, L1'', Lc and A'
Activation of the successor anchor A' first
expand A', r', n1', m, L1'', Lc
X and Y: 1 to 2, already live: not expanded
Then deactivation of the predecessor anchor A
X and Y: 2 to 1, still live: not expanded
the successor ledger, equal to the cold ledger of A'
for one insertion or eviction, at w = 48:
attach A' and the staged nodes (with_retention_metadata)
deactivate [A]: A, r, n1, L1, X, Y and every
object below X and Y cross 1 to 0
activate [A']: X, Y and every object below them
the history; the end ledger is the same
a leaf shared by two parents counts 1 instead of 2;
evicting one alias deactivates it although the
